overall_status: MISMATCH: the four declared projections byte-match locked Ghidra 12.0.4, including complete integrated block/op/slot order, first-seen object alias equivalence, primary flags, active/heritage-known state, definitions, descendant counts, consumed-free bank deletion, exact second-reader message/state, INDIRECT simultaneous selection and loop-PHI reverse-slot wiring. Whole-function and module behavior does not match: exception transport is Rust panic versus Ghidra LowlevelError, and Rust cannot retain Ghidra's nullable reserved slot after the caught setup error. Refinement, overlap inputs, revisit markers, guards/calls/stores/loads/returns, joins, multi-pass state and error injection outside these four cases remain UNTESTED.
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; register delay=0, stack delay=1
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Fresh Funcdata per case. single_free_promotion, indirect_simultaneous and loop_phi_reverse_slot run one canonical Funcdata::opHeritage call after structureLoops/calcForwardDominator/buildInfoList; double_descendant_error directly calls Funcdata::opSetInput twice and catches the setup-time boundary error. No Action tree or C emission.
analysis_options.prestate: All observed PcodeOps are created with production newOp/opSetOpcode, fully inserted into named BlockBasic objects through opInsertEnd before order observation, and connected through opSetInput/opSetOutput/newUniqueOut/newVarnodeIop. Free reads are distinct bank objects with one descendant. The loop is entry->header, header->body, header->exit, body->header.
analysis_options.observation: Five fixed-order lines. Each case records pre-state and complete post-state relevant to the boundary. order traverses the current BlockGraph list and each block's live op list in execution order; for every op it emits output then every declared input slot, with a first-seen alias id, storage class, input/written/free/constant/annotation class, exact descendant count, primary flags, activeHeritage, heritageKnown and defining-op label. Additional fields record pass, old-bank deletion, alias equalities, free-with-reader census, exact caught error, and unsorted PHI slot->predecessor->input mapping.
analysis_options.normalization: Only raw object addresses are replaced by deterministic first-seen aN ids, preserving all equality/alias relations. Unique-space offsets and raw IOP pointer offsets are omitted because they are implementation allocation identities; size, class, flags, definition and descendants remain. The Rust Vec missing reserved-null input after the caught second-reader panic is projected as the same declared s0=null slot as Ghidra; this known representation difference is not claimed MATCH. No block, op, predecessor, slot or descendant order is sorted or removed.

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options and cases; no floats
cases: single_free_promotion: entry block contains read=COPY(fresh free register 0x100:8)->unique. One opHeritage must allocate/promote a distinct formal input, rewire slot 0, erase the old descendant and delete the consumed free from the bank.

double_descendant_error: two already-inserted COPY ops; first reads one free register 0x110:8, then installing the same free in second slot 0 must report exactly 'Free varnode has multiple descendants' before changing that Varnode's descendants, flags, free/def state or bank membership.

indirect_simultaneous: prior=COPY(C8:0x21)->register 0x120:8; ind=INDIRECT(prior,IOP(target))->same register precedes target=INT_ADD(fresh free same register,C8:0x22). renameRecurse must bypass ind output for target and select prior because ind and target happen at the same time.

loop_phi_reverse_slot: entry write to register 0x130:8, header reader, body read/write step, exit reader on entry->header, header->body/exit, body->header. Natural placement must create one leading header MULTIEQUAL; reverse predecessor slots must bind entry to init and body to step, all three free reads must be deleted, and header/body/exit reads must alias the phi output.

observation_schema.format: One envelope plus four fixed-order UTF-8 case lines, final newline
observation_schema.op_order: BlockGraph list order, then BlockBasic live list order; output then declared input slots in ascending slot order
observation_schema.varnode_state: first-seen alias id; storage/size; C/A/I/W/F class; live descendant count; numeric primary flags; activeHeritage; heritageKnown; defining op
observation_schema.mutation: old free bank membership/deletion; new slot identity and descendants; exact exception pre/post Varnode state; PHI slot reverse-edge mapping

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-heritage-free-ssa-current-crate-v1 plus sorted length-prefixed tracked Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/build.rs/src/sleigh_shim paths and bytes

build.oracle: Runner exports the complete decompiler/cpp subtree from the locked commit, rebuilds libdecomp.a in a private temporary tree, and links the C++ fixture there.
build.comparand: Runner refuses any full tracked crate-tree hash drift, serializes cargo build --offline --locked --lib with /tmp/rugra-cargo-build.lock, and uses CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rugra-target-heritage-free-ssa. On this host that exact dedicated target path is a verified symlink to ~/.cache/rugra-target-heritage-free-ssa so the tmpfs quota cannot truncate artifacts.
build.private_observer: The locked Funcdata prefix layout shim is used solely for Heritage::buildInfoList, mirroring startProcessing funcdata.cc:166; no oracle source is modified.
